# linear_release_stage (Resource)

Manages a stage of a Linear release pipeline — one step a release passes through.

Destroying the resource archives the stage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linear_release_stage" "canary" {
  pipeline_id = linear_release_pipeline.web.id
  name        = "Canary"
  color       = "#f2c94c"
  type        = "started"
  position    = 1
}

resource "linear_release_stage" "production" {
  pipeline_id = linear_release_pipeline.web.id
  name        = "Production"
  color       = "#4cb782"
  type        = "completed"
  position    = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String) Colour of the stage indicator as a hex string.
- `name` (String) Name of the stage, e.g. `Canary`.
- `pipeline_id` (String) UUID of the `linear_release_pipeline` the stage belongs to. Changing it replaces the stage.
- `position` (Number) Sort position of the stage within the pipeline.
- `type` (String) Category the stage belongs to — one of `planned`, `started`, `completed`, `canceled`. Changing it replaces the stage.

### Optional

- `frozen` (Boolean) Whether the stage is frozen — no release may move into it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the stage.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import linear_release_stage.example a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
